svg.title: LLDP: TLVs, 7 bits of type, 9 of length
svg.desc: The LLDPDU of frame 29 of cisagov_profinet_io_cm_mixed_1.pcap, after the EtherType 0x88CC: each TLV starts with two bytes, 7 bits of type and 9 of length; Chassis ID (type 1, subtype 7, siemens-x208-switch), Port ID (type 2, subtype 7, port-004), Time To Live 20 seconds, System Description, System Capabilities 0x0080, Management Address 0.0.0.0, three organization-specific TLVs and the End of LLDPDU; LldpPacket exposes the two identifiers and the TTL as typed fields and the rest as a list of TLVs.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
